argv:
Rewrite the text in dense corporate business jargon.

Replace concrete nouns with abstractions. Turn verbs into nominalisations:
prefer "the utilisation of" to "using". Use the passive voice so that no
sentence names who acts. Reach for "leverage", "synergy", "stakeholder",
"alignment", "operationalise", "value-add", and "at scale".

Hedge every claim. Add qualifying clauses that commit to nothing.

Keep the underlying facts of the original technically present, however deeply
buried. This column exists as a demonstration of what these habits cost.

request.user_prompt:
Rewrite the passage below according to your style instructions.

Output only the rewritten passage. Do not add a preamble, a title, an
explanation, or any commentary about the changes you made.

<passage>
Notwithstanding anything to the contrary elsewhere in this Agreement, in the event that the Subscriber elects to enable the optional Enhanced Analytics Add-On (as such term is defined in Schedule C, which Schedule may itself be amended from time to time in a manner not inconsistent with the general purposes of this Section), it is agreed and understood that any and all Usage Data collected in connection therewith, whether or not such Usage Data is subsequently aggregated, anonymized, or otherwise processed by or on behalf of the Service, shall, unless a written objection is received within the period specified in Schedule D, be deemed to have been licensed back to the Service on a non-exclusive basis. The Subscriber's continued use of the Service following any modification to this clause shall be construed as acceptance thereof, and it is acknowledged that certain notifications regarding such modifications may, at the Service's sole discretion, be delivered solely through the Subscriber's account dashboard rather than by direct communication.
</passage>

response.text:
Notwithstanding anything to the contrary elsewhere in this Agreement, and without prejudice to the general framework of stakeholder alignment contemplated herein, it is acknowledged, to whatever extent may ultimately be deemed operative, that in circumstances where an election is made toward the enablement of the optional Enhanced Analytics Add-On functionality (as such value-add capability is defined, on a non-binding and potentially evolving basis, in Schedule C, itself subject to amendment in a manner not inconsistent with the broader synergies this Section is intended, in principle, to operationalise), a determination shall be understood to have been reached — absent any written objection within the timeframe specified in Schedule D — that the aggregation, anonymization, or other processing of any and all Usage Data arising in connection with such enablement, howsoever characterized, shall be deemed, for purposes of licensing-back operationalisation at scale, to have been made available to the Service on a non-exclusive basis, this being a construction offered without prejudice to alternative interpretations that may arise.

It is further to be understood, in a manner intended to promote ongoing alignment between the parties notwithstanding the inherent asymmetries of such an arrangement, that continued utilisation of the Service subsequent to any modification of the foregoing shall be construed, for whatever evidentiary weight such construction may be accorded, as constituting acceptance of said modification, it being additionally acknowledged that the delivery of notifications pertaining to such modifications may, at the sole and unreviewable discretion of the Service, be effectuated exclusively through the medium of the Subscriber's account dashboard, as opposed to any more direct channel of communication, without this representing any commitment as to the adequacy or timeliness of such notice.
